## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `GetStartedWithIcp`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `quick-start`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **GetStartedWithIcp**.

## Step 2: 1. Create a project

1. On the organization home, select **+ Create Project**.
2. <!-- manual: Enter a Display Name (e.g. My Project). The name slug is auto-generated. -->
3. Select **Create**.

## Step 3: 2. Create an integration

1. On the project home page, select **+ Create Integration**.
2. <!-- manual: Enter a Display Name (e.g. My Integration). Integration type defaults to Default profile (Ballerina). -->
3. Select **Create**.

## Step 4: 4. Create an environment (optional)

1. <!-- manual: Go to Environments in the organization sidebar. -->
2. Select **+ Create** and enter the environment name and details.
3. <!-- manual: enter the environment name and details -->
4. Select **Create**.
